title: Locale - Translation Module Data Models Reference

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the Locale data model. It belongs to the Translation Module.

types.name: code
types.description: The BCP 47 language tag code of the locale (e.g., "en-US", "da-DK").The code of the locale in BCP 47 format. For example, `en-US`.

types.name: name
types.description: The human-readable name of the locale (e.g., "English (US)", "Danish").The display name of the locale
